Heidi lives in Frankfurt and has a friend, Clara. However, after spending time at her grandfather's place in the countryside, she yearns to go back and spend time in the open mountain pasture.
A rooster decides to explore the vast landscapes of China. Later, he meets a panda and the two friends begin a journey together.
Little Hakka uses her magical 'Hakka Hat' to fight evil forces threatening nature in an animated children's adventure story.

Danger Mouse, a talented secret agent, and his faithful sidekick, Ernest Penfold, do all they can to thwart the evil plans of Baron Silas von Greenback.
